images.title: Bubble Heights
images.subtitle: 3D modeling of characters and scenery for video games
images.description:
Bubble Heights is a 3D platform and puzzle game starring Coral, a brave young girl who explores the ruins of an ancient civilization in search of a magical artifact capable of saving her village.

The main mechanic consists of shooting water bubbles in different areas of the map, creating aquatic paths through which Coral can swim and advance in her adventure.

In this project I participated as Lead Artist, doing 3D modeling, texturing, concept art and animations. The game was developed together with my university classmates in the Projects course of the third year.

images.title: Kuni
images.subtitle: 3D modeling of an urban hero
images.description:
Kuni is an urban hero able to control the tattoos on his body and use them as weapons. A young tattoo artist, he represents the spirit of freedom, creativity and Japanese culture. He is inspired by a popular character from the Chinese novel Suikoden, reinterpreted with a modern vision.

This project was born from my final thesis, in which I researched in depth the tattoo culture: its history, styles and psychological aspects. The goal was to design a variety of characters inspired by this art.

At the end of my degree, I decided to continue developing one of those characters and create a more professional and polished version in 3D, thus giving shape to the character of Kuni.

images.title: Sneakers
images.subtitle: 3D modeling of a cyberpunk shoe
images.description:
This project is based on the 3D modeling of a cyberpunk style shoe, combining neon light effects, stylized metals and an urban aesthetic.

Its development came out of pure passion and curiosity, with the aim of learning and exploring the design of original fashion pieces.

The personal goal of the project was to learn how to model and texture with a high level of detail, using ZBrush, 3ds Max and Substance Painter. I took care of every little element of the shoe to achieve a realistic and faithful result to the cyberpunk style.

images.title: Electric Generator
images.subtitle: 3D modeling of a realistic prop
images.description:
This project is based on the creation of a realistic prop for video games: a worn and full of parts electric generator, designed to look functional and credible, taking as a reference real generators.

I made it out of pure passion and desire to learn, following a Domestika course.

My personal goal was to learn how to model hard surface objects in a professional way, since up to that moment I was more used to model organic elements in ZBrush.

images.title: Layma
images.subtitle: 3D facial modeling of a cartoon character
images.description:
Layma is a young heroine and artist capable of controlling and giving life to the graffiti she draws, using them to attack and move with agility. She masters the "Model Pastel" style, characterized by explosive energy and dynamism.

This model is a cartoon style reinterpretation of the character I designed during high school, when I developed my first videogame: Spray.

images.title: Rosalia x Flamingo
images.subtitle: 3D modeling of a therianthropic character
images.description:
The project is based on the concept of merging flamenco as an animal and as a genre of music, adapting this union to a monstrous and grotesque creature in the same style of Diablo IW.

The character is based on and interpreted by the singer Rosalía, very associated with this music genre. In addition, the attitude of the artist in the rio scene fits very well for a powerful creature, the aura of diva and majesty that transmits fits with the concept of a powerful divinity of the game.

I did this project as a work for the 3D Modeling course at the university, during the second year of the degree.

images.title: Wood Temple
images.subtitle: 3D modeling of an elven temple
images.description:
This project is the modeling of an elvish style dungeon, set in an ancient fortress of sylvan elves. The structure is built with wood and stone, natural materials characteristic of their culture. It presents curved and elegant shapes typical of their architecture. Inside is a medium-sized dragon, which the tribe worshiped and fed with prisoners.

I made this project as a work of the 3D Modeling subject at the university, during the second year of the career.

images.title: Monster UFO
images.subtitle: 3D modeling of a cartoon vehicle
images.description:
The project consists of modeling a basic UFO, reinterpreted with a Monster Truck fusion, where a rebel alien customizes his ship with his own style.

I developed it as a second work of the 3D subject at the university, looking to give a different and original approach to the classic concept of creating a simple flying saucer.

images.title: Maria Singer
images.subtitle: Modeling and 3D printing of a figure
images.description:
A personalized gift in which I modeled a chibi figure of the person to whom I gave it, trying to reflect their hobbies and personality.

Afterwards, I printed it in a 3D resin printer and painted it by hand with acrylic paint.

images.title: Road to the moon
images.subtitle: 3D modeling of a Monument Valley level
images.description:
The project consists of the design and modeling of a level inspired by Monument Valley, based on the concept "Road to the Moon". To convey this idea, I took as a reference a scene from the animated series Steven Universe, in which a water tower rises to the moon.

I developed it as the first work of the 3D subject at the university, where we started to learn how to model simple shapes.

images.title: Cartoon Crew
images.subtitle: Cartoon character illustration
images.description:
Compilation of illustrations of different cartoon characters that I have created at different times as part of my personal practice and love for drawing.

Each piece reflects my interest in exploring expressions, shapes and colors, keeping a cartoonish and dynamic style.

images.title: Empathy Code
images.subtitle: Illustration of characters and scenery
images.description:
Illustrations for Empathy Code, a 2D platform videogame with cartoon style, where the main character, Sydan, has the ability to swap positions with characters and objects.

The project stands out for its vibrant color palette and simple shapes, as well as a piecewise illustrated character design, which allows to animate it directly in Unity using the animation tree system.

images.title: Green Heart
images.subtitle: Cartoon character illustration
images.description:
Character illustrations for the design of Green Heart, a 2D platform and combat videogame set in a steampunk world with art nouveau aesthetics.

The main character, Gary, is a scientist who must investigate a mysterious biological activity detected in an abandoned botanical garden on an island.

images.title: Nubipoly
images.subtitle: Parodic illustrations of a board game
images.description:
Illustrations and complete design of a board game, a parody version of Monopoly created as a personalized gift for a friend. The squares, cards and lucky cards include jokes and inside references based on your personality.

The entire game, including the cards, the board and the different elements, was designed, illustrated and physically printed, with a comical and cartoonish style, full of exaggerated expressions, costumes and humorous situations that convey a fun and relatable tone.

images.title: Tabuun Universe - Characters
images.subtitle: Illustrations of magical characters for the design of a narrative universe.
images.description:
Tabuun Universe is a personal project that consists of the creation of a complete universe: with its own worldbuilding, characters, power system and multiple stories that intertwine within a vast cosmos of action and magic.

I generated illustrations of several characters that I imagined for this universe, some more detailed and others in sketch format, in order to quickly represent their personality, role and essence within the world I have been imagining.

images.title: The Games gathered No one
images.subtitle: Illustrations of a board game for Nadie Sabe Nada
images.description: This is a project I designed for the radio show Nadie Sabe Nada, created as a fan of the show. From its internal narrative and recurring jokes, I elaborated a board game proposal with cartoon and caricature illustrations that represent the humor and essence of the show.

images.title: ROSALIA the Video Game
images.subtitle: Tribute video game UI design
images.description:
"Rosalía: The Videogame" is a music platform adventure that takes players into the universe of the artist Rosalía, with scenarios inspired by her songs and albums, especially El Mal Querer, and rhythmic challenges that reflect her fusion of flamenco and urban style.

I made the project for a university course of UI design, with which I obtained an honors degree.

I designed the user interface (UI) and the art of scenarios and characters of the video game. For this I made a complete study and design process that included the development of the briefing, the persona profile, the benchmarking, the creation of the moodboard, the development of wireframes and mock-ups, and finally the style bible.

links.text: UI Design - Rosalia the Video Game

images.title: Keep Working
images.subtitle: Complete artwork of a prototype mini-game
images.description:
Keep Working is a 2D platform videogame with comical and chaotic physics, developed for the Serious Games course at the university. In addition to its design, I made the illustrations and visual art, using a cartoon and comic style that contrasts with the critical tone of the project.

The story takes place in a warehouse of a logistics company dedicated to online shopping, where the player assumes the role of a worker who must sort and move boxes against the clock, facing surreal and exaggerated situations that convey stress, confusion and lack of rest. The pace is constant, frenetic and challenging.

At the end of the game, the game reveals that all the situations experienced are inspired by real cases, with the aim of raising the player's awareness of the harsh working conditions and motivating them to support the cause of the affected workers.

images.title: Aether
images.subtitle: Pixelart for a 2D video game Top Down
images.description:
Aether is a top-down action-puzzle RPG video game, developed in pixel art style. Its main mechanics combine strategy and creativity, based on the fusion of primary elements; plant, water, fire and electricity, which can be mixed together to create defenses, circuits or tools necessary to advance in the game.

To carry out the project, I fully designed the mechanics and levels, in addition to making all the visual art in pixel art style and implementing the entire game in Unity. Aether has two levels that progressively introduce the main mechanics, with the possibility of expanding the project in the future thanks to the originality of its gameplay.

It was developed for the Projects subject of the first university course, with which I was able to obtain an honors degree.

images.title: Minigames - Art
images.subtitle: Complete artwork for mini-games
images.description:
Compilation of illustrations and 2D designs created for several mini-game prototypes.
The style is cartoon, with a comic tone, simple, colorful and coherent, looking for a friendly aspect in each proposal.

These are projects done for the AI course at the university, where in addition to developing the code to implement navigation systems and AI behaviors in NPCs, I decided to create all the visual art for the minigames.
This way, I was able to give them more identity, cohesion and flexibility in the design, enhancing the overall experience.

images.title: Events - Branding
images.subtitle: Flyer and event content design
images.description:
Design of advertising flyers, posters and graphic pieces, including posts for social networks and general branding, aimed at promoting parties and various themed events.

Each poster presents a different theme, seeking to convey a unique essence for each event, while maintaining an overall visual coherence through the use of specific color palettes and styles.

images.title: Techno Phone
images.subtitle: Design of a folder for Tecnocampus
images.description:
Graphic design of a folder for the Tecnocampus university. During my time at university I participated in a contest open to students from all areas, in which creative proposals were sought for the official folder for the next academic year.

My proposal consisted of designing a folder that simulates a phone or a large tablet, taking care of every detail such as buttons, camera and custom applications, which integrated useful information from the university. The goal was to promote, inform and provide an original identity through design.

images.title: Rent me this bike - Branding
images.subtitle: Branding and mockups for motorcycle business
images.description:
Alquílame esta moto is a business dedicated to renting equipment for motorcyclists. I was personally in charge of creating the branding and defining the visual identity of the project, developing a coherent style and a corporate color palette that transmits professionalism and confidence.

I designed business cards, flyers and advertising and informative graphic pieces, designed for both physical printing and digital dissemination in social networks. In addition, I developed a fully functional website, where users can calculate orders automatically and contact easily, accessing all the necessary information about the service.

images.title: Relaxium Experience
images.subtitle: Branding and mockups for massage business
images.description:
Relaxium Experience is a brand created for a massage service at the Llafranc Tennis Club, for which I developed the complete design and visual identity, including logo, colors and general graphic style.

I designed cards, tickets and vouchers for sessions, as well as informative flyers about the different services, maintaining a unified and coherent identity. The proposal sought to convey balance, peace and relaxation through the use of soft colors and an aesthetic that evokes wellness and health.

images.title: El Bedel de la Uni
images.subtitle: Management and creation of content for a novel's networks
images.description:
I designed the complete visual identity of the book, ensuring aesthetic coherence between the cover, the color palette and the overall graphic style. I generated graphic pieces for social media and print designs for the launch of the novel. I also developed a web page and a book trailer to reinforce its diffusion campaign.

El Bedel de la Uni is a romance and mystery novel set in Barcelona in the 80s. Carla, a young university student in love with a professor, is involved in a chilling event that makes her life take a totally unexpected turn.

links.text: Web - El Bedel de la Uni
Booktrailer - El Bedel de la Uni

images.title: Personal Branding
images.subtitle: Personal website, portfolio and interactive CV development
images.description:
I developed a complete personal branding to promote myself in a creative and coherent way. I created an interactive and animated resume with an artistic collage style that reflects my identity and skills.

I also designed an animated portfolio, very visual and interactive, where each project has its own detailed section. All the content was integrated into a personal website with a unified and coherent aesthetic. In addition, I included cartoon-like cards that represent me in different roles.

The goal was to show my creative and technical capabilities through the design and functioning of the site itself.

images.subtitle: Tribute video game UI design

images.title: Ping Pong - Bonasport
images.subtitle: Production and editing of a trailer for the Ping Pong section of a gymnasium.
images.description:
Video recording and editing for the presentation of the table tennis section of the Bonasport gymnasium.

The project consists of the creation of a video that combines real shots with images generated by artificial intelligence, coherently integrated through careful editing. Traditional editing techniques are used along with innovative digital resources to achieve a professional and consistent visual result.

images.title: El Bedel de la Uni - Booktrailer
images.subtitle: Production and editing of a booktrailer
images.description:
Complete editing of the booktrailer for the novel El Bedel de la Uni, using shots and sounds generated by artificial intelligence, combined with effects, transitions, color correction and tempo adjustment in Adobe Premiere Pro. The piece synchronizes the images with the epic music to convey specific emotions at each moment and arouse the viewer's interest, with the aim of encouraging the purchase of the book.

El Bedel de la Uni is a romance and mystery novel set in Barcelona in the 80s. It tells the story of Carla, a young university student in love with her professor, who becomes involved in a chilling event that changes her life completely.

images.title: Metamorphosis - Trailer
images.subtitle: Production and editing of a trailer for a thematic event
images.description:
Shooting and editing of a promotional trailer for the carnival themed event Metamorphosis. The project included filming with camera and drone, plus full editing in Adobe Premiere Pro.

Color correction, visual effects, sound design and a carefully selected epic soundtrack were performed. The music was precisely timed to match the intensity and rhythm of each scene.

images.title: Porky's Day Out
images.subtitle: Animation and cartoon editing
images.description:
2D animation and video editing of a cartoon short film in a comic and cartoon style. The project combines illustration, animation and audiovisual editing skills.

Characters and scenarios were designed in Photoshop and Illustrator, and later animated in OpenToonz. Finally, the material was edited in Adobe Premiere Pro to create a short film with rhythm and visual humor. In addition, a specific narrative and shot planning was developed to guide the structure and tone of the short film.

images.title: Bubble Heights
images.subtitle: 3D modeling of characters and scenery for video games
images.description:
Bubble Heights is a 3D platform and puzzle game starring Coral, a brave young girl who explores the ruins of an ancient civilization in search of a magical artifact capable of saving her village.

images.title: Cowardly Space Trooper
images.subtitle: 3D body animations of a character
images.description:
3D animation of a humanoid character for a video game, created in 3ds Max. Several animations were made representing different states and situations of the character within the game environment.

This project was developed for the course Introduction to 3D Animation, where the objective was to animate a space trooper. I decided to give him an original approach, representing him as a cowardly and clumsy soldier who constantly trembles. This creative direction allowed me to give him personality and exaggerate his gestures to clearly express his attitude.

images.title: Evil Tom Holland
images.subtitle: 3D body and facial animation
images.description:
3D body and facial animation of a character, developed as a sequence in which the model had to interpret a phrase through lipsync, combining facial expressions and body movements in a coherent way.

The project was done for the 3D Animation course, where the model of Tom Holland was to be animated reciting a phrase taken from a movie. The interpretation was focused on reflecting a dark and malicious character, according to the tone of the audio, which conveyed a slow, sinister and restrained feeling.

images.title: Aether
images.subtitle: Creation of a 2D video game Top Down
images.description:
Aether is a top-down action-puzzle RPG video game, developed in pixel art style. Its main mechanics combine strategy and creativity, based on the fusion of primary elements; plant, water, fire and electricity, which can be mixed together to create defenses, circuits or tools necessary to advance in the game.

To carry out the project, I fully designed the mechanics and levels, in addition to making all the visual art in pixel art style and implementing the entire game in Unity. It was developed for the Projects subject of the first university course, with which I was able to obtain an honors degree.

images.title: Paper Pioneers
images.subtitle: Creation of a 3D platform videogame
images.description:
Paper Pioneers is a 3D platform video game prototype in which a tiny spring merges with different everyday objects to acquire new skills and escape from a school. The environment has a narrative and comic tone that is expressed visually, without the need for dialogue.

The project was developed directly for the Level Design course at university, where both the spatial and narrative aspects of the environment had to be considered. The goal was not only to create a functional platform level, but also to make the stage itself tell a story.

The designed level takes place in a classroom, where small humorous and recognizable details of typical school situations are integrated. Different physical elements such as elastic surfaces on chairs or slippery areas were used to enrich the gameplay. In addition, the player guidance was carefully worked to maintain a clear orientation of the player, especially considering the small scale of the character and the vastness of the environment.

images.title: Star Crossed
images.subtitle: Creation of a narrative video game
images.description:
Star-Crossed is a narrative video game centered on the story of Jessica, a young psychologist who, while trying to help others, must also face her own inner demons. When her partner mysteriously disappears, she is drawn into a series of paranormal events that could alter the fate of the world.

The game combines decision-making, skill management and elements of chance. The player must carefully choose his actions to avoid game overs, improve his abilities and overcome the various plot obstacles. The narrative is immersive and branching, with several characters to interrogate and multiple paths leading to the same outcome from different perspectives.

The story, characters and decision trees were designed in detail, and then implemented in the Narrat engine, which uses its own language.

images.title: Spray: My first video game
images.subtitle: Creation of a third-person shooter
images.description:
Spray was my first contact with the world of video games since I was a child. It is a third-person shooter in which a group of graffiti artists, able to materialize their works, faces a society dominated by an authoritarian and robotic regime.

The project was part of my research work in high school, at a stage when I still had no experience in video game development or in the field of 3D. This first creation allowed me to explore and experiment with the basics of design and programming, awakening my interest in the industry and marking the beginning of my career in this field.

images.title: Portal - Gameplay Prototype
images.subtitle: Level design and implementation of Portal mechanics
images.description:
This project is based on the implementation of the mechanics of the video game Portal as a programming and development practice in Unity, made for the university course of 3D Development.

The level integrates in a functional way the main features of the original game; creating portals, grabbing and throwing objects, interaction with elastic and sliding materials, buttons, doors and enemies, as well as including new mechanics, such as changing the size of portals and objects when passing through them.

images.title: Super Mario Xmas
images.subtitle: Development of a Mario 64 level with a Christmas theme
images.description:
The project is based on the recreation of the first level of the video game Super Mario 64, reinterpreted with a Christmas style and approach. Developed as a programming and development practice in Unity for the university course of 3D Development.

The level reproduces in a functional way the main features of the original game: all types of Mario's movements, camera effects, obstacles and moving platforms. In addition, a Christmas setting was added to give the project its own personality and experiment with the implementation of new elements within the Unity 3D environment.

images.title: Basic Shooter - Gameplay Prototype
images.subtitle: Implementation of a shooter mechanic for 3D games
images.description:
First-person shooter prototype composed of two levels, developed as a programming and development practice in Unity for the university course of 3D Development.

The project includes level design and modeling, as well as the implementation of lighting, shooting mechanics, life system, defense and ammunition. Obstacles, enemies with offensive behavior and tracking, as well as interaction with different objects in the environment were also integrated.

images.title: Guard & Grow
images.subtitle: Development of a mini-game with navigation systems and AI behavior in NPCs.
images.description:
Guard and Grow is a simple top-down clicker-style mini-game in which the player must protect his orchard from crows and flies trying to steal the potatoes. While the farmer harvests them, the player controls a scarecrow that, by clicking on different areas, scares the creatures away using a rechargeable energy system.

The game incorporates navigation systems and AI behavior in NPCs, developed as programming practice for the university's Artificial Intelligence course.

I also created the visual art for the project to give it personality and authenticity.

images.title: Space Grid
images.subtitle: Development of a mini-game with navigation systems and AI behavior in NPCs.
images.description:
Space Grid is a simple top-down clicker mini-game developed to implement navigation systems in Unity within a grid. The game takes place in a maze where an astronaut must collect pieces to open the final door and escape from the level, while being chased by enemies that follow their own routes, deviate when detected and respect restricted areas.

The project incorporates navigation systems and AI behavior in NPCs, developed as programming practice for the Artificial Intelligence university course.

In addition, I created the visual art of the game to give it personality and authenticity.

images.title: Basic Shop - Gameplay Prototype
images.subtitle: Implementation of an exchange mechanic for 2D games
images.description:
This project is based on the implementation of a logic system for a store, which includes interaction, buying and selling mechanics through an interface. It was developed as a programming and development practice in Unity for the university course of 2D Development.

To improve the final result, I incorporated my own recycled character art, adding animations and pose variations to the characters interacting in the store.

images.title: Basic Command - Gameplay Prototype
images.subtitle: Implementation of a command fight mechanic for 2D games.
images.description:
This project is based on the implementation of a command-based combat system, inspired by classic turn-based RPGs. In it, two teams of three characters face each other using a system of life, damage and skills, with selection of attacker and victim. It allows player vs. player, player vs. console or even console vs. console games.

It was developed as a programming and development practice in Unity for the university course of 2D Development.

To give it more life and dynamism, I used my own recycled and animated characters.

images.title: Rent Me This Bike
images.subtitle: Web development for a motorcycle gear rental business
images.description:
I fully developed the website for Alquílame esta moto, a business dedicated to renting equipment for motorcyclists. The website allows users to calculate orders automatically, contact easily and access all the necessary information about the service, offering a clear, functional and professional experience.

In addition, I was in charge of creating all the branding and visual identity of the project, defining a coherent style and a corporate color palette that transmits confidence and professionalism. I also designed business cards, flyers and advertising and informative graphic pieces, designed for both physical printing and digital dissemination on social networks.

images.title: Personal Branding
images.subtitle: Personal web development with portfolio and interactive CV
images.description:
I developed a personal website as the backbone of my professional identity, integrating all my creative content in a unified and coherent way. The site brings together an animated portfolio, very visual and interactive, where each project has its own detailed section, and an animated resume with an artistic collage style that reflects my personality and skills.

In addition, I created cartoon-like cards that represent me in different roles, providing a distinctive and original touch. The whole design responds to a complete personal branding, designed to show my creative and technical capabilities through the style, structure and functioning of the site itself.

images.title: El Bedel de la Uni
images.subtitle: Web development for a book
images.description:
I developed the website for the novel El Bedel de la Uni as the main axis of its launching campaign, conceived to reflect the atmosphere of the story and offer an informative and visually coherent space with the book's identity.

In addition, I designed the complete visual identity, ensuring aesthetic coherence between the cover, the color palette and the overall graphic style. I also created the book trailer and different graphic pieces for social networks and printed materials, thus reinforcing the dissemination of the project in different formats.

El Bedel de la Uni is a romance and mystery novel set in Barcelona in the 80s. It tells the story of Carla, a young university student in love with her professor, who becomes involved in a chilling event that completely transforms her life.

links.text: Web - El Bedel de la Uni

images.title: ERSCE 3D cabinet configurator
images.subtitle: 3D software development for an elevator company
images.description:
I developed an online 3D configurator in HTML and JavaScript using Three.js, a JavaScript rendering engine that allows to generate interactive three-dimensional environments directly in the browser. The project, developed for an elevator company, allows customers to customize cabins in real time through a clear and intuitive interface, from which they can modify measurements, textures, lighting, mirrors and handrails with a high level of detail, obtaining a fluid and realistic visual experience.

The configurator follows the company's corporate identity, applying its colors, typography and logo to maintain a coherent and professional image.

images.title: Rent me this bike - Manager
images.subtitle: Development of a platform for the management of a motorcycle equipment rental business.
images.description:
I developed an internal software (manager) to manage the motorcycle equipment rental business Alquílame esta moto. The application, implemented in Python with HTML web interface, includes: inventory control and reservations, delivery and returns management, smart calendar, interactive map of collaborators and customer manager with customized histories. The objective was to centralize daily operations and improve the traceability of each order, from request to return.

In addition to the internal software, I also developed the website and the branding of the project.

images.title: My internal tools
images.subtitle: Small programs developed to optimize my workflow and streamline tasks
images.description:
I have developed several customized tools to optimize my workflow and streamline specific tasks, each with a specific and distinct function.

These programs allow me a total level of customization, adapting completely to my way of working and to the specific needs of each project, improving efficiency and reducing execution times.

images.title: Tattoo Heroes
images.subtitle: Study and conceptual creation of characters inspired by the tattoo culture.
images.description:
I have designed the characters for an urban action videogame based on my own research study about the tattoo world, in which I analyzed its evolution, styles, meanings and the psychology that motivates people to get tattooed. This project is my Final Degree Project in the Video Game Design and Development career.

Each character is inspired by a specific tattoo style that defines their identity, culture, personality, appearance and skills, giving rise to unique urban heroes, with a strong symbolic and visual charge.

images.title: Mini-games and prototypes
images.subtitle: Other mechanics and level designs applied to mini-games
images.description: Compilation of prototypes and mini-games with mechanics and level design, developed as short projects where the applied design plays a secondary but necessary role to complement the gameplay experience.

images.title: Star Crossed
images.subtitle: Creation of a narrative video game
images.description:
Star-Crossed is a narrative video game centered on the story of Jessica, a young psychologist who, while trying to help others, must also face her own inner demons. When her partner mysteriously disappears, she is drawn into a series of paranormal events that could alter the fate of the world.

The game combines decision-making, skill management and elements of chance. The player must carefully choose his actions to avoid game overs, improve his abilities and overcome the various plot obstacles. The narrative is immersive and branching, with several characters to interrogate and multiple paths leading to the same outcome from different perspectives.

The story, characters and decision trees were designed in detail, and then implemented in the Narrat engine, which uses its own language.

images.title: Tabuun Universe - Worldbuilding
images.subtitle: Design of magical characters for a narrative universe.
images.description: Tabuun Universe is a personal project that consists of the creation of a complete universe: with its own worldbuilding, characters, power system and multiple stories that intertwine within a vast cosmos of action and magic.

images.title: Rent Me This Bike
images.subtitle: Management of a rental service
images.description: Management of an approved motorcycle equipment rental service, designed for those who need to practice or take the motorcycle exam. The goal is to facilitate the whole process, managing the delivery and collection of the material in a fast and comfortable way for each person. In addition, I developed the branding, web and graphic material of the project, creating a coherent visual identity, a functional page with automatic order calculation and promotional pieces for print and social networks.

images.title: El Bedel de la Uni
images.subtitle: Network and content management for a book
images.description:
Responsible for managing and creating content for platforms; Instagram, X (Twitter), YouTube, TikTok, Facebook and LinkedIn, during the process of launching and selling a mystery novel.

The work included the development of a communication and branding strategy to give identity to the universe of the work: presentation of characters, places in the book, curiosities and exclusive materials. We also managed the diffusion of the booktrailer, the presence in bookstores, and the development of a website dedicated to the project.

images.title: Thematic events
images.subtitle: Planning and coordination of events and theme parties
images.description:
Conducting and dynamizing thematic events, organizing and guiding recreational activities such as games, contests and interactive quizzes during parties and meetings.

As a complement, I made graphics, crafts and small hand-painted trophies for the activities and games of each event.

images.title: Escape rooms and gymkanas
images.subtitle: Planning and creation of scenerooms
images.description:
Planning, design and management of escape rooms and outdoor gymkhanas, organized occasionally as a hobby with family, friends, colleagues and in some school events, driven by my passion for games and escape room type experiences.

I also created graphics, maps and materials needed to set and structure each experience.

images.title: Video games at Uni
images.subtitle: Management of videogame projects during my university studies
images.description: Management and monitoring of the development of several projects, controlling time, tasks and the organization of the production process. All of them were carried out between my university stage and the end of high school, covering a wide variety of genres, work methods and teams, with different roles and levels of responsibility in each project.

images.title: March 21 - Catering
images.subtitle: Waiter and event coordination
images.description:
Experience in attention and service in different types of events such as weddings, corporate celebrations, private meetings and music festivals such as the Cap Roig Festival.

I have managed the bar, served food passes and participated in the previous set up and general support during the catering.

images.title: Rent Me This Bike
images.subtitle: Consulting and management with people
images.description:
Attention and advice to people during the rental of approved motorcycle equipment, explaining the service and managing deliveries and pick-ups in a fast and convenient way for each user.

In addition, I developed the branding, web and graphic material of the project, creating a coherent visual identity, a functional page with automatic calculation of orders and promotional pieces for print and social networks.

images.title: Games at events
images.subtitle: Dynamization of games in parties and thematic events.
images.description:
Planning and conducting social dynamics and participatory games at parties and themed events, creating experiences adapted to each occasion through music, decoration and interactive proposals that encourage group participation.

As a complement, I designed flyers, posters and graphic pieces to promote the events, adapting each poster to its theme and maintaining an overall visual coherence.

images.title: Escape rooms and gymkanas
images.subtitle: Accompaniment and interaction in escaperooms
images.description:
Dynamization and organization of escape rooms and outdoor gymkhanas, accompanying and interacting with the players during the activity and guiding the experience. Occasionally carried out with family, friends, colleagues and in some school events, driven by my passion for games and escape room type experiences.

I also created graphics, maps and materials needed to set and structure each experience.
